meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aZLI4uETKIjW6g4Vz_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Evaluate:
    title: Evaluate
    type: connector
    description: >
      Evaluates signal records against defined rules to identify matching conditions and generate rule match results.
    on-success:
    - For_Each_Rule_Match: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_aZ1LRHkhdRw0Pruxj_playbook
    inputs:
      Records_to_Evaluate:
        $:ref: $inputs.signal_records
      Rules_to_Evaluate_Against:
        $:ref: $inputs.rule_records
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
  For_Each_Rule_Match:
    title: For Each Rule Match
    type: loop
    description: >
      Iterates through each rule match result to process signal and rule record updates in parallel.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Get_Values
    actions:
      Get_Values:
        title: Get Values
        type: transformation
        description: >
          Extracts signal record ID, matching rule details, UUID, and tracking ID from the current rule match iteration.
        on-success:
        - If_Matching_Rule_UUID_Exists: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          matching_rule:
            title: Matching Rule
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - $:ref: $loops.For_Each_Rule_Match.value
                - matching_rule
              advancedView: false
            inputs:
              expression: $lookup(loops.For_Each_Rule_Match.value,'matching_rule')
              data:
                loops:
                  For_Each_Rule_Match:
                    value:
                      $:ref: $loops.For_Each_Rule_Match.value
            actionType: jsonata
            next: matching_rule_uuid
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          matching_rule_uuid:
            title: Matching Rule UUID
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
                - rule-uuid
              advancedView: false
            inputs:
              expression: $lookup(actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule,'rule-uuid')
              data:
                actions:
                  Get_Values:
                    result:
                      matching_rule:
                        $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
            actionType: jsonata
            next: matching_rule_tracking_id
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          matching_rule_tracking_id:
            title: Matching Rule Tracking ID
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
                - tracking-id
              advancedView: false
            inputs:
              expression: $lookup(actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule,'tracking-id')
              data:
                actions:
                  Get_Values:
                    result:
                      matching_rule:
                        $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          case_record_id:
            title: CASE Record ID
            inputs:
              expression: $lookup(loops.For_Each_Rule_Match.value,'record_id')
              data:
                loops:
                  For_Each_Rule_Match:
                    value:
                      $:ref: $loops.For_Each_Rule_Match.value
            next: matching_rule
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - $:ref: $loops.For_Each_Rule_Match.value
                - record_id
              advancedView: false
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            actionType: jsonata
        entrypoint: case_record_id
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      If_Matching_Rule_UUID_Exists:
        title: If Matching Rule UUID Exists
        type: conditional
        description: >
          Checks whether a valid matching rule UUID exists before proceeding with record updates.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        conditions:
        - action: Update_CASE_Record
          condition:
            $:and:
            - $:not:
              - $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_uuid
              - $:empty: true
        else: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 3f64d6f5-c69c-4f67-b962-77d3ce66e5df
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Execute_Rule:
        title: Execute Rule
        type: emitEvent
        description: >
          Emits a Rule_Execute event with the rule UUID and signal tracking ID to trigger rule execution workflow.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
          eventData:
            Rule_UUID: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_uuid }'
            Tracking_ID: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.case_record_id }'
          sensorName: Rule_Execute
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Update_Rule_Record:
        title: Update Rule Record
        type: recordAction
        description: >
          Appends the signal record ID to the matched rule record's list of records matched.
        on-success:
        - Execute_Rule: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
          appendValues:
            records-matched:
              $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.case_record_id
          applicationId: aHIKL4OPed1qTNWcV
          restrictions:
            groups:
              operation: append
              value: []
            users:
              operation: append
              value: []
          trackingId: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_tracking_id }'
          applicationName: ""
          patchValues: {}
          removeValues: {}
        recordActionType: patch
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 8436dd51-891a-4f03-b5fa-75745c803230
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Update_CASE_Record:
        meta: {}
        title: Update CASE Record
        type: recordAction
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success:
        - Update_Rule_Record: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Updates the CASE record with rule processing status, matched rule UUID, and rule reference information.
        inputSchemaReferenceId: d2a0a3bc-84dd-4587-859d-8ce63d393e81
        inputs:
          applicationName: ""
          applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
          trackingId: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.case_record_id }'
          patchValues:
            rule-processing-status: Processing
            rule-matched: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_uuid }'
            rule-processed-reference:
            - '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Values.result.matching_rule_tracking_id }'
          removeValues: {}
          appendValues: {}
          restrictions:
            users:
              operation: append
              value: []
            groups:
              operation: append
              value: []
        recordActionType: patch
    loop:
      type: for
      each:
        $:ref: $actions.Evaluate.result.published.Rule_Matches
      parallel: true
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Evaluate
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: a56d80af-d6fe-4f8d-b5c9-a9fc30104089
outputSchemaReferenceId: 7321a278-975f-4662-851f-474743763fbe
inputs:
  type: object
